corpusName: Lincoln Deep Corpus (28-document reviewed baseline; LMA v4 inventories complete)
samplingFrame: Core 28-document reviewed baseline drawn from Abraham Lincoln's speeches, letters, and public addresses (1838-1865), fully annotated in lincoln-metaphor-analysis. LMA v4 source inventories are complete through the non-human-review boundary: 48 core documents, 78 validation-tier documents, and 18 additional search-only reference documents. PPW currently registers 36 document metadata records; additional LMA v4 records require PPW source-pack mapping, raw-text import, segmentation, annotation/reliability review, and claim-promotion gates before they become PPW evidence.
notes: PPW #195, #196, and #197 remain the PPW migration anchors for the LMA v4 corpus tiers. The child repository now contains completed source inventories for LMA #113 (48-document core), LMA #114 (78-document validation inventory), and LMA #115 (18 additional search-only reference records). PPW evidence-readiness status remains pending: raw text import, passage segmentation, annotation, human/inter-annotator review, scoring, and claim promotion are not implied by inventory completion.

samplingFrame: 41-document stratified corpus spanning American Revolution, Napoleonic, Lincoln, and Nazi-era cases under Koenigsberg's Law of Sacrifice, selected via the sacrifice-law-workbench manifest-driven pipeline. PPW #149 records proposed PPW case IDs for American Revolution and Napoleon; both still require case folders before their subsets can be imported. Corpus import into PPW is planned for Milestone 17.
notes: American Revolution and Napoleon have proposed PPW case IDs in data/corpora/sacrifice-law-comparative-41/cases.json, but the corresponding PPW case folders do not yet exist. Corpus import planned for Milestone 17. No documents imported yet as of Milestone 15; per-corpus folder created in PPW #138.
